scenario.product: B2B sales and customer engagement platform
scenario.routing_goal: Assign a new inbound lead to the sales representative most suited to the buying motion, geography, language, domain needs, and implementation complexity.
scenario.note: All people and companies in this dataset are fictional. Rep profiles intentionally overlap so routing cannot always be reduced to one field.

reps.name: Maya Chen
reps.typical_company_size: 500+ employees, or smaller organizations with enterprise-grade buying complexity
reps.routing_criteria: Best for North American enterprise or unusually complex deals: Salesforce migration, SSO/SCIM, security review, procurement, regulated buyers, or large multi-team rollouts.

reps.name: Luis Ortega
reps.routing_criteria: Best for Americas SMB/mid-market buyers, especially e-commerce and HubSpot migrations, with standard integrations and relatively fast sales cycles. Supports English and Spanish only. Do not route leads that explicitly require another language unless they can conduct the sales process in English or Spanish.

reps.name: Anna Keller
reps.routing_criteria: Best for DACH buyers, German-language procurement, GDPR/EU data-residency requirements, and mid-market or enterprise manufacturing and B2B technology accounts.

reps.name: Priya Nair
reps.routing_criteria: Best for APAC mid-market/enterprise, especially fintech, multi-country rollouts, complex integrations, identity requirements, and regional implementation complexity.

reps.name: Jordan Brooks
reps.routing_criteria: Best for small, English-speaking buyers with straightforward deployments, agencies, local services, startups, GoHighLevel migrations, and marketing-automation use cases.

reps.name: Sophie Martin
reps.typical_company_size: 250+ employees, or complex EMEA buying motions
reps.routing_criteria: Best for EMEA outside DACH, especially French-speaking or enterprise buyers, multi-country deployments, Salesforce integrations, logistics/professional-services accounts, and complex procurement.
